rounds.idiom: Ngoana ya sa lleng o shoela tharing
rounds.literal: Lesea le rapaletse tharing le sa lle, batho ba feta ba sa bone hore le hloka lebese.
options: Ha o sa bue ka tlhoko ya hao, batho ba ka se o thuse
Ngoana o tshwanetse ho robala kapele
Batho ba tshwanetse ho rata masea feela
Ho molemo ho tsamaya o le mong
rounds.story: E sebediswa ha motho a sa kope thuso kapa a sa bue ka bothata ba hae, ebe o sala a sa thuswe.

rounds.idiom: Ntja pedi ha e hlolwe ke sebata
rounds.literal: Ntja tse pedi di eme ka sebete pela sebata se seholo, sona se shebahala se tshohile.
options: Diphoofolo tse nyane di matha kapele
Ha batho ba sebetsa mmoho ba fenya bothata
Ntja e tshwanetse ho dula hae
Sebata se hlola kamehla
rounds.story: E bolelwa ha batho ba tshwanetse ho kopana le ho thusana hore ba fenye bothata bo boima.

rounds.idiom: Letsoho le letshehadi le hlatswa le letona, le letona le hlatswa le letshehadi
rounds.literal: Letsoho le letshehadi le hlatsoa le letona ka nkhong, le lona le boela la le hlatsoa.
options: Batho ba tshwanetse ho ja ka matsoho
Ho thusa ho tshwanetse ho tsamaya ka mahlakore a mabedi
Ho molemo ho sebetsa o le mong
Matsoho a tshwanetse ho hlatsuwa hoseng feela
rounds.story: Proverb ena e sebediswa ha ho hopotswa batho hore ba thusane, hobane molemo o kgutlela ho ya o etsang.

rounds.idiom: Monna ke nku, o llela teng
rounds.literal: Nku e eme e kgutsitse thoteng, empa mahlo a yona a tletse bohloko.
options: Monna o tshwanetse ho ja haholo
Motho a ka pata bohloko ba hae ka hare
Ho molemo ho lla pela batho bohle
Dinku di bohlale ho feta batho
rounds.story: E bolelwa ha ho buuwa ka motho ya utlwang bohloko kapa mathata empa a sa a bontshe habonolo.

rounds.literal: Pelo e nyane e dutse poleiting, e ja serati jwalo ka dijo tsa mantsiboya.
options: Lerato le etsa hore motho a mamelle
Pelo e kula ha motho a ja haholo
Ho tshwanetse ho phehelwa baeti feela
Motho a ratwe ka sephiri kamehla
rounds.story: Hangata e bolelwa ha motho a mamella bohloko, tieho kapa mahlomola ka baka la lerato.

rounds.literal: Monna o rwetse seromo se boima mokokotlong, hodima sona ho ngotswe lebitso le lebe.
options: Mabitso a malelele a boima
Botumo bo bobe bo tlisetsa motho boima le dihlong
Ho tshwanetse ho ngolwa lebitso la hao kamehla
Meqathatso e mebe e boima ho feta seromo
rounds.story: E sebediswa ho lemosa hore lebitso le lebe kapa botumo bo bobe bo sala motho morao mme bo mo imela.

rounds.literal: Pitsa e se na letho, motho ya lapileng o qetella a khasa seretseng a batla dijo.
options: Tlala e etsa hore motho a robale kapele
Tlala e qobella motho ho etsa dintho tse dihlong
Dijo tse ngata di senya diaparo
Batho ba lapileng ba tshwanetse ho tsamaya feela
rounds.story: Ho buuwa jwalo ha tlala kapa mahlomola di sutumelletsa motho diketsong tseo a neng a ka se di etse ka tlwaelo.

rounds.idiom: Molamu o kobehwa o sa le metsi
rounds.literal: Monna o koba molamu o mongobo habonolo, empa o ommeng wona o thatafala.
options: Lehong le tshwanetse ho omiswa pele
Motho o tshwanetse ho hola pele a rutwa
Ngwana o lokiswa le ho rutwa a sa le monyane
Metsi a etsa hore molamu o robehe
rounds.story: E sebediswa ha ho bolelwa ka kgalemelo, thuto kapa tlwaelo e lokelang ho qalwa motho a sa le monyane.

rounds.idiom: Kgomo e tshwarwa ka lenaka, motho o tshwarwa ka puo
rounds.literal: Monna o tshwere kgomo ka lenaka, e mong yena o emiswa ke mantswe a monate.
options: Batho ba tshwanetse ho tsamaya le dikgomo
Motho o susumetswa kapa o laolwa ka mantswe le puo
Kgomo e matla ho feta motho
Ho molemo ho bua hanyane kamehla
rounds.story: E bolelwa ha ho hopotswa hore tsela eo o buang ka yona e ama batho, dikamano le tumellano.

rounds.literal: Moshanyana o tshwere maoto a hae ka matsoho a ntse a matha ka lebelo.
options: Ho dula fatshe o phomole
Ho matha kapa ho baleha ka potlako
Ho hlatsoa maoto hantle
Ho sebetsa ka matsoho le ka maoto
rounds.story: Polelo ena e sebediswa ha motho a baleha kapa a potlaka haholo ho tloha sebakeng.

kids.literal: Ngwana o loma meno ka thata ha a leka ho sututsa lebokose le boima.
options: Ho bina ka lentswe le phahameng
Ho mamella bohloko kapa bothata
Ho ja dijo tse thata feela
Ho tsheha haholo
kids.story: Re e sebedisa ha motho a tiya pelo mme a mamella bothata.

kids.literal: Ngoanana o shebile kuku e kgolo feela, mahlo a hae eka a batla ho e ja.
options: Ho lakatsa ntho eo o e bonang
Ho ja ka potlako haholo
Ho pheha dijo tse monate
Ho koala mahlo ha o ja
kids.story: E bolelwa ha motho a batla ntho feela hobane a e bone.

kids.idiom: Ho ba le leleme le lelelele
kids.literal: Moshemane o na le leleme le lelelele le batlang ho fihla koping ya tee.
options: Ho bua haholo o sa itlhokomele
Ho kgona ho bina hantle
Ho rata dijo tse monate
Ho bua butle haholo
kids.story: Polelo ena e sebediswa ho motho ya buang haholo kapa ya arabang hampe.

kids.idiom: Ho ba le tsebe e thata
kids.literal: Moshanyana o na le tsebe e kang lejwe, mantswe a otla a boela morao.
options: Ho utlwa hole haholo
Ho rata mmino haholo
Ho hana ho mamela
Ho robala haholo
kids.story: Re rialo ha ngwana a sa mamele ha a bolellwa.

kids.literal: Bana ba fiela jarete ba bososela, mafielo a sa ba lome hohang.
options: Mosebetsi o etsa hore motho a kule
Ho se tsabe mosebetsi hobane o molemo
Bana ba tshwanetse ho bapala feela
Mosebetsi o etswa bosiu feela
kids.story: E ruta bana hore mosebetsi o motle, mme botsoa ha bo thuse.

kids.literal: Ngwana o phahamisa letsoho ka sehlopheng, potso ya hae e fofa jwalo ka nonyana.
options: Ho botsa ha o sa tsebe
Ho bua ntle le ho nahana
Ho tsheha moruti
Ho qoba batho ba baholo
kids.story: E bolelwa ho kgothatsa ngwana hore a botse ha a sa utlwisise.

kids.literal: Lelapa le dutse le kgutsitse tafoleng, dijo le pososelo di tletse.
options: Dijo di ngata ha pula e na
Ha ho ena le kgotso, bophelo bo ba monate
Ho tshwanetse ho tholwa kamehla
Chelete feela ke nala
kids.story: Re e sebedisa ho bontsha hore kgotso e tlisa thabo le bophelo bo botle.

kids.literal: Moshanyana o eme lefifing, buka e bonesa tsela ka lebone le lenyane.
options: Bosiu bo loketse dipapadi
Ho se tsebe ho tlisa mathata
Libuka di tshwanetse ho patwa
Mabone a tima kapele
kids.story: Polelo ena e hopotsa bana hore ho ithuta ho ba thusa ho bona tsela.

kids.literal: Pelo e nyane e pentilwe ntsho, e sutumetsa metswalle hole.
options: Ho rata diaparo tse ntsho
Ho ba sehloho kapa ho hloka mosa
Ho robala haholo bosiu
Ho ba le sebete se seholo
kids.story: Re rialo ha motho a sa bontshe mosa mme a utlwisisa ba bang bohloko.

kids.literal: Monna o hlatswa matsoho pela nkho, bothata bo sala fatshe bo le bong.
options: Ho hlwekisa matsoho pele o ja
Ho ikgela thoko bothateng
Ho thusa metswalle ka metsi
Ho bapala ka nkho
kids.story: E bolelwa ha motho a hana boikarabelo mme a re taba ha e sa mo ama.
